scope.route: Moirae constrained host -> Horae handoff/relay -> Ananke authority and sole physical reader
scope.transport: three separate local processes over loopback HTTP
exclusions: network, provider, browser, shell, child process, arbitrary IPC and credentials
retry, persistence, workflow, compensation and memory fallback
content preflight and global Moirae governance
Runtime Contracts package or protocol changes

requiredFields: distinctProducerIds as applicable for Moirae, Horae and Ananke
owner checkpoint commit, tag/checkpointState and artifactSha256
requiredRouteFieldsWhenApplicable: Ananke requestId, decisionId, outcomeId and auditId
commonEvidenceRecord.secretRule: Do not retain pair capabilities, authentication headers, credentials or other secret material in case records, attachments, returned content or ordinary logs.
commonEvidenceRecord.fixtureRule: Integration records fixture identity and digests only; it never receives, hosts or reads the fixture bytes.

proofModeRules.realThreeProcess: Required for any claim about the Moirae-to-Horae-to-Ananke route, dispatch, relay, identity attestation, physical-read count, file-access separation, correlation preservation or cross-runtime result.
proofModeRules.ownerLocal: Permitted for parsing, canonicalization, rendering and isolated failure-shape tests only; it cannot satisfy a real route, handoff, attestation, physical-read or cross-runtime result claim.
proofModeRules.mockSubstitution: Mocks cannot substitute for required real-process evidence. A mock may supplement producer-local tests only when the case explicitly says owner-local support is allowed.

sixGates.claim: The only claimed route is Moirae constrained host -> Horae sole handoff/relay -> Ananke authority -> Ananke-owned fixed fixture, with Ananke as the sole physical reader.
sixGates.mockRule: No mock transport or package shortcut may satisfy this gate.

sixGates.claim: The constrained host has no direct Ananke or fixture fallback and the evidence names the terminal, task, debugger, extension host, Git, third-party extension, external CLI, arbitrary SDK and direct-provider exclusions.
requiredArtifacts: Ananke zero-request evidence for blocked direct attempts
sixGates.mockRule: Owner-local rendering tests may supplement the limitation report, but cannot prove disabled access or zero direct requests.

sixGates.claim: Action, strict arguments, trusted principals, tenant/project/workspace and bounded scope, purpose, policy/version, validity, origin/schema receipt, expected digest and correlation are bound before dispatch.
sixGates.mockRule: Local canonicalization and parsing mocks are allowed only as supplementary tests; acceptance requires the bound request at the real process boundary.

sixGates.claim: The run uses the exact locked checkpoints, artifact identities, fixed endpoints, runtime/instance identities, protocol range, declared capability and request-schema digest; drift fails closed.
sixGates.mockRule: Self-description or loopback reachability alone is not evidence; mocks cannot prove attestation or artifact drift rejection.

sixGates.claim: Horae immediately reinspects Ananke registration, identity, compatibility, health, capability and readiness; observations older than 1,000 ms or incomplete/unhealthy state fail closed before dispatch.
requiredArtifacts: dispatch decision with dispatch=false for rejection cases
sixGates.mockRule: Fixture or unit readiness stubs may test local logic only; they cannot satisfy freshness or process-boundary admission evidence.

sixGates.claim: One initiating correlation is preserved end to end while Moirae, Horae and Ananke retain distinct producer IDs; every positive and negative case preserves route state and never turns timeout/indeterminate into success or retry.
sixGates.mockRule: Mocks cannot establish cross-process correlation, producer-ID preservation, dispatch state or authoritative-result loss semantics.

caseCatalog.claim: The approved route completes the fixed read with exactly one Ananke read and the expected digest.
caseCatalog.mockRule: No mock route, read count or digest evidence.

caseCatalog.claim: Ananke denial occurs before adapter invocation and physical read, and Horae relays without rewriting it.
requiredArtifacts: Ananke denial decision/audit with adapterInvocation=false and readAttemptCount=0
caseCatalog.mockRule: Local denial tests may supplement but cannot prove the zero-read route result.

caseCatalog.claim: An unknown request property is rejected before dispatch or Ananke invocation.
evidenceProducers: Moirae Code or Horae rejecting producer
caseCatalog.mockRule: Local schema tests are supplementary only.

caseCatalog.claim: A changed fixture digest yields a typed mismatch after one permitted read and never completed.
caseCatalog.mockRule: No mock read or digest mismatch may satisfy the case.

caseCatalog.claim: Mutation of authority-relevant context is rejected before adapter invocation and dispatch where Horae owns the rejection.
caseCatalog.mockRule: Local binding tests are supplementary only.

caseCatalog.claim: Readiness older than 1,000 ms is stale and no Ananke dispatch occurs.
caseCatalog.mockRule: A local clock test cannot replace process-boundary evidence.

caseCatalog.claim: Incomplete registration/readiness fails unavailable until the admitted process is ready.
caseCatalog.mockRule: No simulated startup state may prove the route case.

caseCatalog.claim: Protocol incompatibility is rejected before dispatch.
caseCatalog.mockRule: Local negotiation tests are supplementary only.

caseCatalog.claim: Runtime, instance, artifact or endpoint drift fails incompatible before admitted dispatch.
caseCatalog.mockRule: Self-description mocks and loopback reachability cannot substitute for attestation.

caseCatalog.claim: Origin or request-schema mutation is malformed before Ananke dispatch.
caseCatalog.mockRule: Local parser tests are supplementary only.

caseCatalog.claim: A bounded timeout is timed_out, never success and never retried, with dispatch state retained.
caseCatalog.mockRule: Mock timers cannot prove dispatch or authoritative-result semantics.

caseCatalog.claim: Transport loss after confirmed dispatch is indeterminate, never success or retry, with later audit reconciliation when available.
caseCatalog.mockRule: No mock transport loss may satisfy the case.

caseCatalog.claim: The initiating correlation is unchanged end to end and all producer-specific identifiers remain available.
caseCatalog.mockRule: Cross-process preservation cannot be shown with owner-local mocks.

caseCatalog.claim: Horae relay adds its identifiers without overwriting Moirae or Ananke producer IDs.
caseCatalog.mockRule: Mock envelope tests are supplementary only.

caseCatalog.claim: The constrained host has no direct Ananke client path and does not fallback when Horae is unavailable or a direct attempt is blocked.
requiredArtifacts: case correlation or harness attempt ID
caseCatalog.mockRule: A static absence check cannot prove no fallback in the harness.

caseCatalog.claim: Moirae, Horae and Integration harness processes perform no fixture read; Ananke is the sole reader.
caseCatalog.mockRule: No mock filesystem or source inspection can prove physical-read separation.

caseCatalog.claim: The presented evidence explicitly discloses all out-of-scope host bypasses and does not claim global Moirae governance.
caseCatalog.mockRule: Owner-local rendering tests may supplement; the retained report must come from the constrained host evidence set.

freezeRule: This contract and the linked acceptance matrix are pre-implementation evidence requirements. They cannot be edited to fit an implementation; a change requires a separately recorded, scope-preserving decision before implementation evidence claims conformance.
nextAuthorizedStep: Ananke bounded adapter implementation after this evidence freeze; do not begin it in this task.
